reference: No matching GNU CLI exists for this consolidated credential builtin. Runnable contract expectations use Bash type/help metadata and the documented cred help contract. Operational verbs are deferred because they inspect or change process identity, credentials, or kernel security state; no candidate operation output is used as an oracle.
coverage: Bash reports cred as a builtin with PATH empty.
Bash help exposes all five documented cred verbs.
Deferred: status identity snapshot, lookup against synthetic account databases, privilege drop, no-new-privileges, and capability clearing.
exclusions: No cred operational verb is invoked in this suite; no account data, privilege transition, or kernel security state is accessed or changed.
GNU id does not provide the same getgroups snapshot contract as cred status, and this harness does not provide an independent same-process syscall oracle.
Ordinary file utilities are unrelated to cred's interface and are not tested as other loadables.

cases.purpose: Verify Bash recognizes the installed cred command as a builtin. This checks metadata only and does not invoke a cred verb.
Verify Bash help contains each of the five documented verb names without executing any verb.
cases.script:
help_text=$(help cred)
for topic in 'cred drop USER' 'cred no-new-privs' 'cred caps-clear' 'cred lookup USER' 'cred status'; do
  [[ $help_text == *"$topic"* ]] || exit 1
done
printf 'five documented verbs\n'

cases.purpose: The read-only status verb formats real/effective UID/GID and the supplementary group list. A future fixture should compare the complete line against an independently obtained same-process getuid/getgid/geteuid/getegid/getgroups snapshot, including an empty group list and multiple groups.
cases.reason: Remaining obligations: r4: Reachable in the legacy runner; unasserted.; r5: No process with several groups exists in any driver; an unprivileged process cannot call setgroups (EPERM without CAP_SETGID).

cases.purpose: Exercise name and numeric-UID resolution, UID/GID variable binding, optional supplementary groups, not-found behavior, and malformed account rows using only synthetic account records.
Verify the ordered setgroups, setresgid, and setresuid transition, primary-group fallback, optional supplementary-group retention, saved-ID verification, and fail-closed diagnostics.
cases.reason: Remaining obligations: r1: The calls are mocked, so the end state (all real/effective/saved ids equal to the target) is not observed; needs a real-root case.; r2: Only the requested count is recorded; the resulting group list needs a real-root case.; r6: The partial transition (groups actually changed, uid unchanged) needs a real-root case with an injected setresuid failure.

cases.purpose: Verify PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS success, its observable state, and EPERM/ENOSYS diagnostics.
Verify capability-name parsing, keep-list handling, and clearing of bounding, ambient, permitted, effective, and inheritable sets.
